settings.parameter_basis: Geometry, constant viscosity, surface tension, temperature andpressure are explicit virtual scenario inputs, not a measured brick or admitted glass fit. R is modern SI.
settings.scope: Analytic radial stress/kinematics, independent spatial viscous integral and thermodynamic balances, plus vented-source porosity identity. No trajectory or experimental qualification.

sources.title: Cavitation and Bubble Dynamics
sources.use: Full Rayleigh-Plesset surface traction and closed ideal-gas pressure; creeping infinite-matrix limit derived separately.
Vented spherical-shell porosity law only; experimental glass viscosity and glass-bead qualification not transferred to brick.

sources.selected_model: Finite spherical incompressible Newtonian shell, fixed matrix volume, outer normal traction -p_out, no exterior surface energy, constantT and gamma; closed ideal gas or prescribed pressure venting.
literal_source_cautions: Wadsworthp5prose describeszero porosityat infinite time, but its Eq2.12 has an integrable phi^(-2/3) closure time for constant finite positive viscosity. Distinguish prose from the equation actually used.
Wadsworthp8viscosity prose writes mu=A+B/(T-C); no logarithm is printed while p9figure uses viscosity of10^5to10^13Pa*s. No empirical viscosity parameter admitted until original2014source is checked.

closure_scope: Improper-radius endpoint integral of the printed Eq2.12, finite for positive finite eta/gamma; no simulation beyond zero radius or real material closure claim.
